name: application-bottom-sheet-nav
title: Bottom Sheet Nav
description: A mobile-native bottom sheet with a drag handle, snap-point indicator dots, and an icon-and-label navigation row, anchored to the bottom of the viewport.
useWhen: Building a mobile view where the primary navigation or filter controls should stay reachable at the bottom of the thumb zone.
The sheet needs to support drag gestures between snap heights (peek, half, full) in a real implementation, signaled by the handle and snap dots.
avoidWhen: You're building a desktop or general side-panel overlay — use `Sheet` or `Drawer`, which don't imply drag/snap gesture behavior.
The navigation is simple and always full-height when open — a standard modal `Dialog` is simpler without the snap-point affordance.
responsiveBehavior: The sheet spans the full width of its mobile container and is anchored to the bottom edge; on wider viewports this pattern should be swapped for a standard sidebar or dropdown nav instead of stretching full-width.
accessibility: The drag handle is decorative; provide keyboard-operable snap controls (e.g. buttons) alongside it for non-pointer users in a real implementation.
Each nav item is a real <button> with a visible icon and text label together, not an icon-only tap target.
The active nav item is distinguished by both a color change and (in production) aria-current, not color alone.

variants.title: Filter sheet
variants.description: A phone-frame mockup with an 'Explore' grid behind a bottom sheet showing a drag handle, three snap-point dots, and a four-item icon nav row with Filters active.
accessibility: Each nav destination pairs an icon with a visible text label.

variants.title: Filter sheet (Dark)
variants.description: Bottom sheet nav adapted for dark surfaces, including the device frame, sheet background, and active nav item color.
accessibility: Handle, snap dots, and nav icons all meet WCAG AA contrast against the dark sheet background.
